name: three problem cards fan in under a hard-truth headline
looks: A headline states the catch, its hard word in the accent colour; beneath it, three small labelled cards fan in one after another, each a short problem name over a tiny example snippet (a flooded feed, a stale thread, a removed reply).
build: variant-stack-reveal: three DOM cards ease in on staggered springs with a small seeded offset, each card's label and caption keying in right behind it.
sound: A soft cluster of three settle ticks, one per card.
prompt: State the catch in a short headline with the hard word in the accent colour, then fan in three small labelled problem cards beneath it one after another, each with a tiny supporting example. Use it to turn a single claim into three concrete, specific pain points.
